summary: Independent review of all 246 Chinese units in Qingshi gao military training treatise juan 139 (志一百十四 兵十 训练). The chapter is reign-dated edict and memorial chronology for Qing banner and Green Standard drill reforms, not astronomical biography. Most attestation claims correctly convert witnessed 天聰/崇德/同治/光緒 year phrases to Western event years, but claim-41 and claim-120 retain explicit Western precision on undated citations (s0154, s0192) akin to the Mei Wending pattern. All active-date hints propagate those event-year AD values as person scheduling bounds without chapter life-date witnesses and require repair before chronology approval.

findings.action: Retain s0192 for Zhang’s academy founding as anaphoric 是年 event tied to s0191 in narrative context, or cite s0191 with explicit event-ownership separation; do not treat s0192 alone as bearing 光緒十三年 western precision.
